body:
Round66 curates `data/records/dolomite.yaml` narrowly from the accepted manuscript text and the complete official 22-page supplement. This source follow-up does not allege an unaddressed record error.

Primary sources:
- Daye, Higgins and Bosak (2019), *Formation of ordered dolomite in anaerobic photosynthetic biofilms*, DOI [10.1130/G45821.1](https://doi.org/10.1130/G45821.1).
- MIT accepted manuscript: [hdl.handle.net/1721.1/126802](https://hdl.handle.net/1721.1/126802). The acquired eight-page manuscript has main figure captions but lacks embedded main Figures 1–2.
- Official full supplement: [10.1130/2019187](https://doi.org/10.1130/2019187), including original diffraction, microscopy and Table DR1.

The retained record accepts only the consistently identified illuminated 1 mM Mn consortium arm and source-assigned partially ordered dolomite. It preserves the main/SI gas-recipe difference, dark-control Mn labels and diffraction-index/cross-reference conflicts. It asserts no pure-phase recovery yield or industrial deployment.

Acceptance:
- Acquire and document a lawful complete illustrated main article, or save a bounded failure with a reproducible access handoff.
- Compare Figures 1–2 with original SI DR2–DR10 and Table DR1; resolve or explicitly retain gas recipe, dark-control mapping and reflection-index inconsistencies.
- Seek underlying diffraction/refinement/control metadata through public source routes; distinguish author clarification from reviewer inference.
- If new evidence changes the record, add an immutable history session, repeat affected validation and save an independent successor scientific review against exact final bytes.

Provenance: `research/sources/round66-magnesium/20261014T082237Z-source-investigation.{md,json}` records attempted routes and source hashes. Full paginated issue inventory (129 actual issues, including closed) was searched for Daye, G45821 and dolomite; no duplicate was found in that inventory. Hidden and ignored repository research files were included in the curator's scope search. This is separate from #194 (Tesson brucite) and #198 (Mavromatis carbonate original).
title: Acquire illustrated Daye 2019 dolomite main article and reconcile control/phase labels
